summary: A 23-year-old woman suffered severe injuries after crashing her bike on the Betasso Loop trail. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and Sugarloaf Fire responded, packaged her in a litter, and transported her to a helicopter landing zone just after noon for air-ambulance transfer. She was wearing a helmet at the time of the accident.
location: Betasso Loop trail, Betasso Preserve, Boulder County
notes: Resolves the standing 2016-09-11 dating lead (run 506). Date from RMRG's own dated report ('Sunday, September 11'; 2016-09-11 was Sunday).
